title: relay <cmd> --help runs the command instead of help
what: bin/relay answers `-h`/`--help` anywhere after a subcommand (and after `queue <action>`) with that command's usage lines and exit 0, before any command code runs. Move 1 of each-relay-subcommand-lives-in-its-own-module later moves this into the dispatcher; this fix is the guard until then.
why: 28 Oct, found by the split design's review (bin/relay:467, :206, :332): most subcommands ignore --help and run. `relay install --help` rewrites the global CLAUDE.md, user settings and plugins; `relay calibrate --help` writes the ledger; `relay candidate --help` creates a profile named '--help'. An agent that asks a command for its help changes the owner's machine. Principle 10: the obvious way must be the safe way.
failing_case: `relay candidate --help` in a temporary RELAY_HOME creates a profile named '--help'.
pass_cases: `relay install --help`, `relay calibrate --help`, `relay candidate --help` in a temporary home write nothing and exit 0 with usage text.
Every command in the command table, run with --help in a temporary home, writes nothing (a test walks the table).
